elements.content: Time management is important for everyone. Every morning, I make a list of things I need to do. This includes homework, reading, and playing. I do my homework first because it is important. After homework, I read a book. Reading makes me smart. I save time for playing with my friends, too. Playing is fun and makes me happy. I also help my Mom and Dad at home. At night, I prepare my schoolbag for the next day. This saves me time in the morning. Managing my time makes me feel good and organized.

elements.content:

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

child_list.content: 时间管理
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 时间管理对每个人都很重要。每天早上，我都要列出我要做的事情。这包括家庭作业、阅读和玩耍。我先做作业，因为它很重要。做完作业后，我会读一本书。读书使我聪明。我也留出时间和我的朋友一起玩。玩耍很有趣，也让我快乐。我还会在家帮助我的妈妈和爸爸。晚上，我准备好第二天的书包。这节省了我早上的时间。管理我的时间让我感觉良好，做事也有条理。
child_list.name: 文本框

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
